python_contract.implementation_reason: A learner who later invokes a Foundry agent must distinguish the API contract, the SDK abstraction, and the endpoint address boundary. This packet rehearses those roles over supplied sanitized replicas without installing a package, using an address, or making a call.
python_contract.learner_owned_action: derive one fresh bounded integration record from three supplied sanitized replicas while preserving each API, SDK, and endpoint role, local provenance, a null endpoint value, and unsupported limits
python_contract.gate: 8/8 primary, answer-free remediation for every actually failed check, delayed closed-note API/SDK/endpoint/provenance/authority trace, then 8/8 genuinely blank fresh transfer

ai901_contract.objective_title: Create and test a single-agent solution in the Foundry portal and create a lightweight client application for an agent

primary.case: Configure one prompt agent's model, instructions, and approved tools in Foundry.
Exercise expected behavior, an edge case, and a tool failure in the agents playground.
A lightweight application submits current input to an existing agent interface.
The lightweight application handles the returned agent result or error without granting new permission.

retrieval.case: Use the playground to probe denied-action and tool-failure behavior before publication.
Define stable instructions and attach only the approved tool while authoring the prompt agent.
Send a fresh task from an app to an already defined agent.
Branch locally on the result or error returned to the app.

transfer.case: Choose the model, stable instructions, and allowed tools for a new prompt agent.
A small app sends a new user task to the existing agent boundary.
Inspect ordinary, edge, and failed-tool behavior in the agent testing surface.
The app processes the returned result or error while preserving its action limits.

ai901_contract.gate: 8/8 primary, per-case/per-dimension answer-free remediation selected only from actually scored misses, delayed closed-note 8/8 retrieval, then 8/8 genuinely blank fresh transfer plus separate explanations that portal authoring, portal testing, client invocation, and client result handling remain distinct, and that configuring a tool or receiving a result neither grants permission nor proves truth

evidence_contract.prior_record_reopening: only after the fresh record finalizes; reopen complete RP-007 RP-008 RP-009 and RP-010 records one individually navigable scope at a time without requiring memory of hidden content
evidence_contract.reconciliation_eligibility: require the finalized fresh record plus complete accessible reopened prior scopes; comparison of method provenance and limits remains separately scored from both learning chains and cannot change their evidence
evidence_contract.after_save: clear temporary work and keep only allowlisted finalized evidence, the fresh bounded record, four separate retained prior records, and the separately finalized method-and-limit reconciliation
evidence_contract.resume: restore only finalized dimension evidence and complete retained record metadata, preserve hidden or reopened status, then resume at the first incomplete scored boundary without replay or memory test
